title: Platform Power in News Aggregation
title_zh: DP21789 新闻聚合中的平台权力
authors: Andrey Simonov, Daniil Mikhailov, Ruben Enikolopov, Ruben Durante
official: 官方在线 2026-07-26 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: News aggregators are among the primary gatekeepers of online news, shaping both consumption and production through the algorithms that rank stories and sources. We provide the first large scale estimates of this algorithmic power using the example of Yandex News, Russia’s largest aggregator. Combining archived front pages with 12.3 million published articles and outlet-level traffic data, we estimate that occupying the entire top-5 news block for a day raises an outlet’s traffic by roughly 380,000 visitors. After a 2016 law made aggregators liable for cited content, Yandex halved its references to independent outlets, yet consumers did not penalize the manipulation: its referrals converted readers at the same rate, and its market share did not fall. Removed outlets shifted toward longer articles and stopped optimizing headlines for the algorithm, showing that aggregator algorithms shape not only news consumption but also production.
abstract_zh: 新闻聚合器是在线新闻的主要守门人，通过排序报道和来源的算法，同时塑造新闻消费与生产。我们以俄罗斯最大的聚合器Yandex News为例，首次大规模估算了这种算法的影响力。结合存档首页、1230万篇已发表文章以及媒体层面的流量数据，我们估算出，占据前五名新闻板块一整天可使一家媒体的流量增加约38万访客。2016年一项法律要求聚合器对引用的内容负责后，Yandex将独立媒体的引用量减半，但消费者并未惩罚这种操纵：其引荐的读者转化率保持不变，市场份额也未下降。被移除的媒体转向发布更长的文章，并停止为算法优化标题，这表明聚合器算法不仅塑造新闻消费，也影响新闻生产。

title: Assaf Razin: International economist for a global age
title_zh: 阿萨夫·拉津：全球化时代的国际经济学家
official: 官方在线 2026-07-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: During a distinguished career that spanned more than five decades, Assaf Razin, who passed away in July 2026, established himself as one of the leading international economists of his generation. This column describes how, across a range of topics including international trade, international finance, fiscal policy, taxation, migration, the welfare state, and financial crises, he combined theoretical innovation with an abiding concern for policy and for the ways in which globalisation expands national opportunities while constraining national choices.
abstract_zh: 在跨越五十余载的杰出学术生涯中，于2026年7月逝世的阿萨夫·拉津（Assaf Razin）奠定了其作为同代顶尖国际经济学家的地位。本专栏将阐述他如何在国际贸易、国际金融、财政政策、税收、移民、福利国家及金融危机等一系列议题中，将理论创新与对政策的持久关注相结合，并深入探讨全球化如何在拓展国家机遇的同时约束国家选择。

title: Beyond the First Bond: Market Access and Debt Dynamics in Frontier Economies
title_zh: 超越首次债券：前沿经济体的市场准入与债务动态
official: 官方在线 2026-07-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We examine market entry and post-entry debt dynamics in Frontier Economies by grouping countries based on durability of market access using a two-step framework combining first Eurobond issuance with the reliance on private external creditors, validated through an unsupervised K-mean clustering. A discrete-time event LOGIT model finds that favorable global liquidity conditions and investor appetite open issuance windows for countries, but domestic pull factors—income, institutions, growth, and reserve buffers—ultimately determine success of market entry. Post-entry, Frontier Economies shift rapidly toward market borrowing, with looser fiscal stance as new financing source is unlocked. Along increased exposure to rollover and global financial cycle risks, debt decomposition exercise shows a worsening interest–growth differential and rising debt, driven mainly by primary deficits and higher interest burdens. Results underscore the need for credible medium-term fiscal frameworks, stronger debt management, and reserve buffers to manage the transition to market financing.
abstract_zh: 我们通过两步法框架，将国家按市场准入的持久性进行分组，结合首次欧元债券发行与对私人外部债权人的依赖程度，并借助无监督K均值聚类进行验证，从而考察前沿经济体的市场进入及进入后的债务动态。离散时间事件LOGIT模型发现，有利的全球流动性条件和投资者偏好为各国打开了发行窗口，但国内拉动因素——收入水平、制度质量、经济增长和储备缓冲——最终决定了市场进入的成功与否。进入市场后，前沿经济体迅速转向市场借贷，随着新融资来源的解锁，财政政策趋于宽松。在面临展期风险和全球金融周期风险加剧的同时，债务分解分析显示，利息-增长差恶化且债务上升，主要源于基本赤字和更高的利息负担。研究结果强调了建立可信的中期财政框架、加强债务管理以及储备缓冲的必要性，以应对向市场融资的转型。

title: Stanley Fischer Memorial Lecture: Public Debt and Central Banks — The World Bank Group ABCDE Conference
title_zh: 斯坦利·费希尔纪念讲座：公共债务与中央银行——世界银行集团ABCDE会议
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper, based on the Stanley Fischer Memorial Lecture that the author delivered at the Annual Bank Conference on Development Economics (ABCDE) 2026, examines two structural impediments to broad-based economic development: dysfunctional central bank currency systems and inadequately resolved sovereign debt burdens. On currency, the paper argues that floating exchange rate regimes and multiple exchange rate systems—as practiced in countries such as Ethiopia, Nigeria, and Egypt—systematically transfer wealth from low-income wage earners to a narrow-privileged class, deepening poverty rather than alleviating it. Using Ethiopia as a central case study, the paper documents how successive devaluations have raised the national poverty rate from 33 percent in 2016 to a projected 43 percent by 2025, while eroding the real value of development assistance disbursed in local currency. The paper proposes that currency stabilization, low-cost digital payment infrastructure, and unsterilized central bank intervention offer a more direct path to rising median incomes than current IMF-endorsed exchange rate flexibility. On sovereign debt, the paper evaluates the performance of the G20 Common Framework and the Global Sovereign Debt Roundtable against the benchmark of the 1989 Brady Plan, finding that contemporary frameworks have generated intensive creditor engagement but minimal net present value reduction for debtor countries. Key failures identified include the absence of a single comparable discount rate for measuring debt relief, incomplete participation by China and commercial creditors, growing opacity in collateralized sovereign transactions, and the risks posed by value recovery instruments to the durability of restructuring agreements. The paper concludes that neither the Common Framework nor the Global Sovereign Debt Roundtable, in their current forms, are fit for purpose, and calls for replacement frameworks that prioritize measurable median income gains over creditor accommodation. Absent reforms on both fronts, per capita income growth in low-income developing economies is projected to remain at approximately 2 percent annually, leaving 5.6 billion people with incomes less than one-tenth of those in advanced economies and widening the global development gap.
abstract_zh: 本文基于作者在2026年发展经济学年度银行会议（ABCDE）上发表的斯坦利·费希尔纪念演讲，探讨了阻碍广泛经济发展的两大结构性障碍：功能失调的央行货币体系与未充分解决的主权债务负担。在货币方面，本文指出，浮动汇率制度及多重汇率体系——如埃塞俄比亚、尼日利亚和埃及等国所实行的制度——系统性地将财富从低收入工薪阶层转移至少数特权阶层，加剧而非缓解贫困。以埃塞俄比亚为核心案例，本文记录了连续贬值如何使全国贫困率从2016年的33%上升至2025年预计的43%，同时侵蚀了以本币拨付的发展援助的实际价值。本文提出，相较于当前国际货币基金组织认可的汇率弹性政策，货币稳定、低成本数字支付基础设施及未冲销的央行干预措施，为提升中位收入提供了更直接的路径。在主权债务方面，本文以1989年布雷迪计划为基准，评估了二十国集团共同框架与全球主权债务圆桌会议的表现，发现当代框架虽促成了密集的债权人参与，但对债务国而言净现值削减微乎其微。识别出的关键失败包括：缺乏衡量债务减免的统一可比贴现率、中国及商业债权人参与不完整、抵押主权交易日益不透明，以及价值回收工具对重组协议持久性构成的威胁。本文结论认为，共同框架与全球主权债务圆桌会议目前的形式均不适用，并呼吁建立以可衡量的中位收入增长而非债权人妥协为核心的替代框架。若这两方面改革缺失，低收入发展中经济体的人均收入增长预计将维持在每年约2%的水平，导致56亿人口的收入不足发达经济体的十分之一，从而扩大全球发展差距。

title: Additionality and Asymmetric Information in Environmental Markets: Evidence from Conservation Auctions
title_zh: 环境市场中的额外性与信息不对称：来自保护拍卖的证据
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Mechanisms that aim to reduce environmental degradation at low cost can be undermined when participants’ conservation actions are not marginal to the incentive — or “additional” — as the lowest-cost participants may not be the highest social value. We investigate this challenge in the Conservation Reserve Program’s auction mechanism for ecosystem services, linking bids to satellite-derived land use. Three-quarters of marginal auction winners are not additional. The heterogeneity in counterfactual land use introduces adverse selection. We develop a model of bidding and additionality to quantify welfare implications. Alternative auctions increase efficiency by using scoring rules that incorporate expected land use impacts.
abstract_zh: 旨在以低成本减少环境退化的机制，当参与者的保护行为并非激励的边际效应——即“额外性”——时，可能会被削弱，因为成本最低的参与者可能并非社会价值最高的。我们在保护储备计划的生态系统服务拍卖机制中研究这一挑战，将投标与卫星衍生的土地利用联系起来。四分之三的边际拍卖获胜者不具备额外性。反事实土地利用的异质性引入了逆向选择。我们构建了一个投标与额外性模型，以量化福利影响。替代性拍卖通过采用纳入预期土地利用影响的评分规则来提高效率。

title: Going Viral: Protests and Polarization in 1932 Hamburg,
title_zh: 病毒式传播：1932年汉堡的抗议与极化
authors: Bruno Caprettini, Marcel Caesmann, Hans-Joachim Voth, David Yanagizawa-Drott
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Abstract Political polarization is a growing concern in many countries. Are mass protests merely a sign of increasing cleavages, or do they polarize societies? In this paper, we estimate the impact of Nazi marches in 1932 Hamburg, using granular data from 622 voting precincts during 6 elections. We show propaganda can persuade – but it does by raising the share of areas with high levels of Nazi support. Importantly, marches can also backfire, repelling voters. Thus, protest marches lead to polarization. These effects diffused through social networks, measured as contagion patterns across neighborhoods from the 1918 Spanish flu outbreak. The electoral effects of social spillovers are of similar importance as direct exposure, and grow over time.
abstract_zh: 摘要 政治极化已成为多国日益严峻的挑战。大规模抗议究竟是社会裂痕加剧的表征，还是导致社会极化的动因？本文利用1932年汉堡622个投票区在六次选举中的微观数据，评估纳粹游行的影响。研究表明，宣传具有说服力——但其作用机制在于提升纳粹支持率较高区域的占比。关键在于，游行也可能产生反效果，即疏远选民。因此，抗议游行最终导致社会极化。这些效应通过社会网络扩散，其传播模式可通过1918年西班牙流感期间跨社区传染路径进行测度。社会溢出效应带来的选举影响与直接接触效应同等重要，且随时间推移持续增强。

title: From Minor Ailments to Major Illnesses: A Practical Framework for Valuing Morbidity in Environmental Policy Analysis
title_zh: 从轻微不适到重大疾病：环境政策分析中疾病负担评估的实用框架
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Environmental decisions often impact health, yet morbidity valuation remains challenging, with current approaches like cost-of-illness (COI) measures and Quality-Adjusted Life Years failing to reflect individuals’ willingness to pay to avoid adverse health states. This paper introduces a novel framework for valuing morbidity across health conditions, deriving willingness-to-pay (WTP) estimates using widely available preference weights and a baseline condition with known WTP. Our analysis reveals WTP estimates significantly exceeding commonly used COI measures, indicating undervaluation of health states in policy evaluations. Sensitivity analyses highlight variations consistent with those for the value of statistical life, underscoring the method's robustness. This framework offers a practical tool for integrating morbidity into analyses of environmental policy.
abstract_zh: 环境决策常影响健康，但疾病负担的估值仍面临挑战。当前的成本-疾病法（COI）和质量调整生命年等指标未能反映个体为避免不良健康状态而愿意支付的金额。本文提出一种跨健康状况评估疾病负担的新框架，通过广泛可用的偏好权重和已知支付意愿的基准健康状况，推导出支付意愿（WTP）估计值。分析显示，WTP估计值显著高于常用的COI指标，表明政策评估中健康状态被低估。敏感性分析揭示了与统计生命价值一致的变异特征，凸显了该方法的稳健性。该框架为将疾病负担纳入环境政策分析提供了实用工具。

title: Infrastructure or Knowledge? Investment Priorities for Promoting the Adoption of Digital Health Tools
title_zh: 基础设施还是知识？促进数字健康工具采纳的投资优先序
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: As COVID-19 pandemic accelerated the digitalization of healthcare, prompting large public investments in the sector, it remains unclear whether the initial shock generated a stable adoption of digital health tools and the full exploitation of their functionalities. Using the case of the Electronic Health Records (EHR) in Italy, we show that a remarkable increase in its use in the aftermath of the pandemic is not necessarily associated to an equal understanding of its scope and functions by potential patients. Exploiting a 2020 reform and variation in pandemic exposure, we show that a one-standard- deviation increase in exposure increased EHR reported use by 39%, driven by records feeding and medical needs. We then leverage a December 2024 national media campaign on the EHR to conduct an original survey focused on its adoption. Among the main evidence is that the acknowledgment of the EHR existence does not translate into effective knowledge, access, or regular use. Engagement is more strongly associated with trust and digital attitudes than with most traditional socio-economic factors. Progress along the adoption chain depends on perceived needs, institutional confidence, and willingness to engage with digital tools. To provide an understanding of how to increase perceived benefits and willingness to engage with the EHR, we randomize information treatments based on the Technology Acceptance Model. Overall, our findings suggest that the effectiveness of large-scale digital health investments depends critically on citizens' awareness, trust, and engagement, and that more tailored information campaigns are needed to improve the general literacy of digital tools once they are introduced or potentiated.
abstract_zh: 随着新冠疫情加速医疗数字化进程并推动该领域大规模公共投资，尚不明确的是，这一初始冲击是否催生了数字健康工具的稳定采用及其功能的充分开发。以意大利电子健康档案（EHR）为例，我们发现疫情后其使用量显著增长，但潜在患者对其范围与功能的认知未必同步提升。利用2020年改革及疫情暴露程度的差异，我们证明疫情暴露程度每增加一个标准差，EHR报告使用率将提升39%，这一增长主要由记录录入和医疗需求驱动。随后，我们借助2024年12月全国性EHR媒体宣传活动开展了一项聚焦其采纳情况的原创调查。主要证据表明：对EHR存在的认知并未转化为有效知识、实际访问或常规使用。相较于大多数传统社会经济因素，用户参与度与信任度及数字态度关联更为紧密。采纳链条的推进取决于感知需求、制度信心及数字工具使用意愿。为理解如何提升EHR的感知收益与使用意愿，我们基于技术接受模型随机分配信息干预。总体而言，研究结果表明：大规模数字健康投资的有效性关键取决于公民的认知、信任与参与度，且需通过更具针对性的信息宣传活动，在数字工具引入或强化后提升公众对其的普遍素养。

title: Drafting and Free-Riding in Mass-Start Triathlon: Evidence from a COVID-19 Start-Format Discontinuity
title_zh: 大规模出发铁人三项中的跟风与搭便车：基于COVID-19出发形式断点的证据
official: 官方在线 2026-06-02 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Drafting in the swim leg of mass-start triathlon transfers a hydrodynamic cost advantage to the bike and run, where it surfaces as a change in relative rank. I use cross-stage rank improvement as a reverse proxy for free-riding and study its determinants in a ten-year panel of athlete × event records centred on 2020, when COVID-19 response policies replaced mass starts with individually staggered starts and mechanically curtailed drafting. A compact two-stage contest model, in which drafting enters the bike–run stage as a multiplicative cost shifter, organises the predictions. Identification combines pooled OLS with athlete and event fixed effects and a sharp regression-discontinuity design at the 2019/2020 cut-off. Free-riding was substantial before 2020, fell sharply in 2020 (a local-linear RDD estimate of about −31 rank places; a local-cubic estimate of about −92), and recovered only partially afterwards. The gains are largest for weaker swimmers and deeper drafting positions, the gender gap is modest, and they rise with swim-group size at an estimated log–log elasticity of about 0.43. The 2020 disruption thus acts as a contraction of the feasible set for free-riding, and its recovery is uneven rather than broad-based.
abstract_zh: 在集体出发游泳赛段中跟游所产生的流体力学成本优势会转移至自行车与跑步阶段，并表现为相对排名的变化。本文以跨赛段排名提升作为搭便车行为的反向代理指标，基于以2020年为中心的十年期运动员×赛事面板数据，研究其决定因素——2020年新冠疫情应对政策将集体出发改为间隔出发，从机制上限制了跟游行为。通过构建紧凑的两阶段竞赛模型（将跟游作为乘数型成本转移因子纳入自行车-跑步阶段）来组织预测。识别策略结合了混合OLS回归、运动员与赛事固定效应，以及以2019/2020年为断点的锐化回归断点设计。2020年前搭便车现象显著，2020年急剧下降（局部线性RDD估计值约为-31个排名位次；局部立方估计值约为-92），此后仅部分恢复。游泳能力较弱的运动员和跟游位置更靠后的选手获益最大，性别差异较小，且收益随游泳组规模扩大而增加（估计对数-对数弹性约为0.43）。因此，2020年的冲击相当于收缩了搭便车的可行集，其恢复呈现非均衡特征而非全面复苏。
